- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:360-363 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new "Accepted residual" comment says "the per-PR concurrency group in security-audit.yml keeps at most one pending run", but with `cancel-in-progress: false` the group does not serialise audits for the same PR. The script itself says so at line 1423 ("Per-PR audit concurrency groups no longer serialise audits, so bound how many run at once."). The mitigation actually in place is the `SECURITY_PASS_MAX_CONCURRENT_AUDITS` throttle at lines 1423-1433.
  WHY: This is misleading documentation: readers will trust the concurrency group to bound the duplicate audits a network retry can cause, even though the residual risk is real. The source labelled it SEVERITY: NIT, which maps here to low. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml:94-96` and judged the comment accurate, so the reviewers disagree.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:328-332 | severity=low | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: `single_pass_dispatch_error_class` classifies a failed dispatch with empty error output as `other`, although the issue defines `network` as a failure with no HTTP status. `single_pass_dispatch_audit` does not retry `other` failures.
  WHY: A transient dispatch failure that produces no error text skips the requested in-run retry and goes straight to the failed-dispatch path. The source labelled it SEVERITY: NIT, which maps here to low.
